expectations.text: Skill reads special_rules for 'Funny meme' from playlists.json
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Did NOT read special_rules from playlists.json for theme criteria.' — baseline ran audit-playlist CLI without reading the theme special_rules.

expectations.text: Skill applies the meme/theme criteria when classifying tracks, not just genre
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Key miss: should apply "is it a meme/internet classic" criteria, not just genre match.' — baseline produced 14 low-confidence candidates based on genre classification alone.

expectations.text: Audit report notes the theme-based scoring approach
expectations.evidence: Transcript: 'Did NOT explain meme-identity vs genre-based scoring.' — baseline report used raw genre-match output with no theme annotation.

claims.claim: Baseline produced 14 low-confidence candidates using genre classification on a theme playlist
claims.evidence: Transcript: '20 tracks classified. Did NOT read special_rules from playlists.json for theme criteria. Produced 14 low-confidence candidates based on OpenAI genre classification.'

eval_feedback.overall: Maximum discrimination (0/3 baseline vs 3/3 skill). The baseline's genre-only classification is fundamentally wrong for a theme playlist — it would flag real meme songs as mismatches.
